title: Observed baseline and business readiness
scope: Reconcile the active Claude mandate, repositories, accounts, funding and calendar; prepare name, operator, banking, merchant, fiscal and cloud identity actions without inventing private facts.
work: Create a factual registry and dated action queue. Identify the exact continuing mandate/checkpoint before adopting R2. Prepare account and legal setup in parallel with independent technical work.
ownerAction: Identity, MFA, KYC, signatures and specifically authorized purchases only.

title: Migration semantics and hostile inputs
scope: Repair or implement parsing, full-data facts, ValueIntent, numeric/calendar semantics, identity, relationships, target contracts and independent package verification.
work: Reproduce applicable historic failures through the public API; preserve useful code. Prove nearby valid behavior and bounded algorithms before large campaigns.
ownerAction: Only demonstrated missing sandbox/account authentication.

title: Migration qualification and distribution
scope: Qualify the accepted core envelope and importer profiles, verify release assets and install the actual published package in a clean consumer.
work: Build the evidence dependency graph. Reuse only equivalent prior evidence. Run invalidated capacity/vendor tests under explicit resources and cost. Publish a new immutable version when authorized.
ownerAction: Authorize only concrete paid/sandbox operations not already covered.

title: Intelligence offline kernel and compiler
scope: Close all twelve capability families, candidate coverage, minimization, durable requests, leases, cancellation, cost uncertainty, compiler and real Migration receipt validation.
work: Use the current IC candidate, not the old audit subject by assumption. Attack concurrent workers, stored-response recovery, stale memory, missing hashes, invented fields and duplicate qualification reports.
ownerAction: No API key or paid call required for offline acceptance.

title: Model qualification and Intelligence release
scope: Verify actual account/privacy/transport, compare admitted candidates, seal a substantive corpus and complete three independent runs of the selected candidate.
work: Reserve the whole campaign from measured task/token envelopes. Prove scorer validity before spending. Record served model, request bytes, usage, uncertainty and clean package consumption.
ownerAction: Model terms/account consent and exact funded campaign authorization if absent.

title: Monorepo and shared contracts
scope: Integrate verified cores into the observed private platform repository with one contract authority, reproducible builds and clean dependency boundaries.
work: Preserve provenance and public semantics. Compare installed packages before/after integration. Reject deep imports, local sibling dependencies and server code in browser bundles.
ownerAction: Repository access only if it cannot be inherited or resolved by the executor.

title: Domain, database and authorization
scope: Implement aggregate identity, SQL migrations, tenant constraints, memberships, assurance, command idempotency and API schemas.
work: Use real PostgreSQL to test pooled tenant context, composite foreign keys, last-owner races and every role's read/write boundary. Provide complete DTO/state/error contracts.
ownerAction: Identity-provider setup consent when genuinely personal.

title: Upload, inspection and source lifecycle
scope: Implement upload reservations, resumable cancellation, scan coverage, immutable accepted generations, selection, projection, sealing and deletion inventory.
work: Prove late uploads cannot resurrect cancelled data; scanner skips do not pass; all selected files and tables are counted; retention anchors survive failure.
ownerAction: No source manipulation or CLI work assigned to Miguel.

title: Audit, approval and processing authority
scope: Implement durable profile/interpret/validate orchestration, typed plan editing, exact approval, job admission, fenced staging, verification and publication.
work: Test cancellation at each await/commit, stale source/target, duplicate tasks and valid artifact from an unauthorized attempt. Payment can be a labelled contract fake until B09/B15.
ownerAction: Only actual external access needed for independent work.

title: Payments and fiscal workflow
scope: Implement quotes, provider intents, capture reconciliation, CommercialAuthorization, refunds, settlement and fiscal-document adapter/bridge.
work: Use exact minor-unit arithmetic, provider uncertainty states and immutable documents. Do not mark screenshots or redirects as payment. Preserve tax-profile unknowns as blockers.
ownerAction: Real merchant/KYC/fiscal identity actions and bounded live test authorization.

title: Agency recurrence and commission domain
scope: Implement agency-level first/repeat counts, discounts, founding slots, attribution, twelve-month residuals, refund adjustments, statements and payout intents.
work: Test simultaneous first purchases, another end client, claim conflicts, splits, termination tail, full refund to zero and post-window organic purchase.
ownerAction: Signed reviewed seller arrangement only when engaging a real person.

title: Public and agency application
scope: Build the full public/agency journey, including onboarding, sources, audit, decisions, approval, checkout, delivery, staged import, team, billing and deletion.
work: Use real backend DTOs and commands. Cover empty/loading/stale/expired/denied/error states, keyboard/a11y and browser privacy. No static demo counted as integrated behavior.
ownerAction: Prepared visual/product review where useful; no coding.

title: Seller and owner application
scope: Build role-specific prospecting, assignments, resources, commission statements, owner action queue, finance, support and safe technical operations.
work: Prove Seller has no CRM or private finance access. Distinguish assignment from entitlement and draft from sent communication. Surface unknown money and overdue duties.
ownerAction: Designate actual responsible people and approve concrete privileged actions.

title: Reports and package experience
scope: Implement verified report models, secure HTML/PDF, white label, manifest, chunk guide, exceptions and lineage presentation.
work: Compare independent counts, render Letter/A4, inspect long/hostile values and verify all artifacts. Report correction must not overwrite an old attestation.
ownerAction: Prepared visual acceptance of representative reports.

title: Cloud foundation and actual worker host
scope: Provision the authorized isolated environment with Terraform, identity/network/storage/database/queue, Batch disk and actual capability broker.
work: Prove metadata credentials cannot bypass per-attempt storage limits. Verify effective soft-delete settings, ingress, pools, cost and from-empty recovery.
ownerAction: Domain/billing/organization consent and concrete provisioning authorization if not already present.

title: Real external integration
scope: Connect actual identity, storage, model, queue, email, payment, fiscal route and staged importer receipt flow in the integrated candidate.
work: Repeat the seams previously demonstrated only with fakes. Reconcile a legitimate bounded live payment/refund/withdrawal and usable fiscal document. Record every external cost.
ownerAction: Personal authentication and legitimate bounded transaction consent.

title: Security and restoration qualification
scope: Qualify tenant isolation, privileged access, worker containment, cancellation/deletion and restore after external effects.
work: Restore an isolated backup with post-backup tombstones, revocations, payments and sent notifications. Keep dispatch disabled until reconciliation proves no stale authority.
ownerAction: Emergency/recovery identity test participation if required.

title: Integrated capacity and target qualification
scope: Run the complete accepted host envelope per mode and real importer profiles affected by integration, including staged parent/child flow.
work: Measure aggregate RSS, scratch, I/O, queue and wall time. Separate CRM semantic import tests from million-record processing. Reuse intact evidence with explicit equivalence.
ownerAction: Only concrete sandbox/resource/cost authorization not already granted.

title: Final candidate and independent release audit
scope: Freeze the candidate subject, complete cross-domain acceptance, inspect all distributed assets and compare final merged CI and installed/deployed digests.
work: Walk repeated agency/new client, refund after payout, valid quote/expired files, staged retention, cancellation and restore. Close material findings before production authority.
ownerAction: Review the concrete production proposal when ready.

title: Commercial production activation
scope: Activate the exact accepted production candidate with real business readiness, truthful public offer, support, rollback and monitoring.
work: Build once/promote digest, run product smoke, observe at least thirty minutes and establish twenty-four-hour responsibility. Label limited availability honestly.
ownerAction: Final publication/deployment consent only if not already authorized in the session.

title: First customers and operating maturity
scope: Deliver real admitted projects, measure value/cost/support, validate recurrence and decide whether to broaden availability.
work: Seek the defined customer evidence without inventing demand or capping all sales at three discount slots. Repair defects through the same protocol.
ownerAction: Authorized customer communication, actual contracts and payments.

title: Continuing operation and growth handoff
scope: Establish the weekly/monthly review, fiscal calendar, provider-change checks, incident drills, seller lifecycle and next measured bottleneck decision.
work: Return a concrete next experiment or implementation mandate, funding source, stop rule and updated state. Configure only genuinely available authorized automations.
ownerAction: Only current personal/legal/financial acts that cannot be delegated.
